title: HR, Marketing & AI-Operations Intern
description:
**About Us**  
Serving Indian healthcare since 2006, Sara Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. is an established medical devices and healthcare brand. We are currently executing a high\-growth strategic reset—transitioning from traditional medical trading into a margin\-led, private\-label MedTech innovator. With a portfolio spanning Respiratory Care, Chronic Disease Monitoring, and Eldercare, our products are trusted by premier government institutions, offline dealer networks, and thousands of e\-commerce customers nationwide.  
**Role Summary**  
We are seeking a highly adaptable, tech\-savvy HR, Marketing \& AI\-Operations Intern to join our corporate office in New Delhi. This is not a traditional administrative internship. You will be a hybrid "force multiplier" for our leadership team, utilizing cutting\-edge AI tools (like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Canva AI, and automation workflows) to radically accelerate our talent acquisition, digital marketing content creation, and distributor outreach campaigns.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. AI\-Driven Talent Acquisition \& HR (40%)

* **Pipeline Building:** Use AI prompting to draft highly targeted job descriptions, social media hiring posts, and candidate outreach messages.
* **Screening \& Sourcing:** Screen resumes across portals (Indeed, Internshala, LinkedIn) against specific rubrics, using AI to help summarize and rank top talent for roles like Field Sales Executives and Inside Sales.
* **Interview Coordination:** Coordinate interview schedules and handle basic onboarding documentation for new hires.

2\. Next\-Gen Marketing \& Content Creation (40%)

* **B2B Collateral Generation:** Use AI writing and design tools to rapidly create product flyers, WhatsApp broadcast copy, and promotional trade scheme pitches for our distributor outreach.
* **Digital Content:** Co\-create engaging visual and textual content for our e\-commerce touchpoints (Amazon/Flipkart) and social channels to build brand equity for our hero MedTech categories (Nebulizers, BP Monitors, Air Mattresses).
* **Market Copywriting:** Craft compelling product descriptions, email newsletters, and institutional pitch decks.

3\. Distributor Outreach Support \& Intelligence (20%)

* **Database Enrichment:** Assist the sales team by cleaning and organizing distributor databases using smart formatting and basic data tools.
* **AI\-Assisted Research:** Use AI to synthesize market trends, map out regional healthcare hubs, and analyze competitor product listings to give our sales team an edge.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree (BBA, B.Com, Mass Comm, or MBA).
* **Mandatory AI Literacy:** Active, daily experience using GenAI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) for writing, brainstorming, or research. Familiarity with AI image/design tools is a massive plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Hindi.
* An entrepreneurial mindset—you love figuring out how to do a 4\-hour task in 30 minutes using smart tools.
* Highly organized, visually creative, and comfortable multi\-tasking in a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description** **Technical Recruiter \- Senior** **Location \- Pune****Experience \- 6\+ yrs in Technical Recruitment****Employment Type \- Full\-Time****Department \- Human Resource/Talent Acquisition****Reports To \- Head Of HR****Industry \- AI\-Powered EdTech**  

EDMO (goedmo.com) is an AI\-first EdTech company headquartered in Pune, India, building agentic AI systems and intelligent enrollment automation workflows for US universities and higher education institutions. Our engineering teams work on cutting\-edge multi\-agent AI platforms, LLM\-powered products, and enterprise\-grade SaaS solutions that directly impact student enrolment and institutional revenue.
We are scaling fast and looking for a seasoned Technical Recruiter who has walked the technical path themselves — someone who understands what a great DevOps pipeline looks like, can intelligently debate NestJS vs. Spring Boot fit for a backend role, and knows why a candidate's RAG architecture experience matters.  

Website: https://goedmo.com **Role Overview**
As a Technical Recruiter at EDMO, you will own end\-to\-end talent acquisition for our most critical and complex engineering, AI, and solutions roles. You will partner directly with technical hiring managers and founding team members to build pipelines for roles across Agentic AI, Full Stack Engineering, Platform \& Infrastructure, Sales Engineering, and Solution Architecture.
This is not a transactional recruiter role. We need someone who can have a credible first technical conversation with candidates, assess depth vs. surface\-level knowledge, and build quality pipelines — not just quantity. **Key Responsibilities****End\-to\-End Technical Hiring*** Own the full recruitment lifecycle for roles including Agentic AI Developers, Backend Engineers, Full Stack Leads, DevOps/Platform Engineers, Solution Architects, Security Analysts, and Business Analysts
* Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies on LinkedIn, Naukri, and community channels for niche technical profiles
* Conduct structured pre\-screen interviews to assess technical fit, role alignment, communication, and motivation — independently and without relying solely on JD checklists
* Coordinate and manage interview panels, ensuring timely feedback loops and reducing pipeline drop\-off

**Technical Assessment \& Pipeline Quality*** Apply working knowledge of tech stacks (Python, Node.js/NestJS, TypeScript, Salesforce Apex, LangChain, RAG, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS/GCP) to evaluate candidate profiles accurately
* Distinguish genuine technical depth from surface\-level proficiency — especially for AI/ML, Agentic AI, and Cloud\-native roles
* Identify integrity signals during pre\-screens (e.g., silence\-then\-polish patterns, inability to explain own project contributions) and flag accordingly
* Maintain ATS hygiene (Keka or equivalent) with real\-time status updates, pre\-screen notes, and structured disposition records

**Strategic Talent Acquisition*** Build and maintain warm pipelines for high\-frequency technical roles to reduce time\-to\-offer without compromising quality
* Design and iterate structured question banks per role to standardise panel evaluation and improve R1\-to\-R2 conversion quality
* Track and report on pipeline metrics: funnel conversion rates, offer\-to\-DOJ ratios, CNS rates, and source effectiveness
* Manage offer negotiations, counter\-offer risk, post\-acceptance engagement, and early dropout prevention
* Contribute to employer branding and talent positioning for EDMO within the Pune and pan\-India tech community

**Stakeholder \& Leadership Collaboration*** Conduct regular pipeline review calls with hiring managers and leadership (twice weekly or as required)
* Prepare concise, recruiter\-authored pipeline status reports — not dashboard exports — covering role\-by\-role progress, blockers, and next steps
* Proactively flag misaligned JDs, sourcing channel issues, or panel capacity gaps to leadership with recommended solutions
* Partner with the People team on onboarding coordination and offer rollout post\-acceptance

**Required Qualifications****Experience*** 6\+ years of hands\-on technical recruitment experience, with at least 2–3 years focused on AI/ML, Cloud, or Software Engineering roles
* Prior experience working in a technical role (e.g., junior developer, DevOps associate, QA engineer, solutions support, technical BA) before transitioning into talent acquisition — mandatory
* Demonstrable track record of closing hard\-to\-fill, niche technical roles within competitive timelines
* Experience recruiting for startups or high\-growth technology companies is strongly preferred

 **Technical Domain Knowledge*** Working familiarity with software engineering stacks: Node.js / NestJS, Python, TypeScript, Java — enough to evaluate stack depth on a pre\-screen call
* Understanding of AI/ML and Agentic AI landscape: LLMs, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), vector databases
* Awareness of DevOps and platform engineering concepts: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS / GCP, Terraform, Kafka, microservices
* Ability to read a resume with technical context — not just match keywords, but assess architecture depth, ownership scope, and project scale

 **Recruitment Skills*** Structured pre\-screen interviewing: ability to design and execute pre\-screen scripts with probing follow\-ups for vague answers
* Sourcing: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Naukri, talent communities, alumni networks
* ATS management: Keka, Greenhouse, Lever, or equivalent — real\-time pipeline hygiene is non\-negotiable
* Offer management: counter\-offer mitigation, relocation risk assessment, post\-offer engagement
* Metrics and reporting: pipeline funnel analysis, conversion rate tracking, leadership\-ready reporting in plain, recruiter\-authored language

 **Preferred Qualifications*** Prior background in software development, DevOps, QA automation, or technical pre\-sales before moving into talent acquisition
* Experience recruiting for EdTech, SaaS, or enterprise AI product companies
* Familiarity with AI\-powered ATS/CRM tools and recruitment automation workflows
* Exposure to US\-market or international hiring processes (nice\-to\-have, not required)
* Strong professional network in the Pune / Mumbai tech ecosystem

**What We're Not Looking For****Please do not apply if you:*** Have only ever recruited for non\-technical roles and transitioned into tech recruitment via keyword matching alone
* Require a hiring manager to explain basic tech concepts before every pre\-screen call
* Are primarily a relationship manager or RPO recruiter with no experience owning pipelines end\-to\-end
* Treat ATS updates as an afterthought rather than a real\-time practice
* Cannot independently assess whether a candidate's claimed AI/ML experience is genuine or surface\-level

**What You'll Get*** Direct access and visibility with EDMO's founding and leadership team
* Opportunity to shape talent acquisition strategy for a fast\-scaling AI\-first product company
* Work on genuinely interesting, hard\-to\-fill roles at the frontier of AI and EdTech
* Pune onsite role with a collaborative, low\-bureaucracy team culture
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and impact

title: Head of Business
description:
**About the Company**

We are a 10\-year\-old B2B e\-commerce company headquartered in Singapore and with operations in the Philippines, built around one mission: **helping small, independent grocery stores compete and thrive** \- through better procurement, logistics and access to financing.

Over a decade, we've grown into a significant business in the Philippines \- over 3,000 people, tens of thousands of small store owners served, and backed by **KKR, Temasek and IFC**, among others.

A year ago, we brought the model to India. The opportunity here is large and the problem is familiar: millions of Kirana stores are underserved by formal distribution and cut off from the financial tools they need to grow.

We started in Kolkata. We've been setting up the business from scratch \- finding a warehouse, hiring the first team, experimenting and figuring out what actually works with Indian Kirana stores, and getting the unit economics to a place we're comfortable with. That part is done

**We are now ready to scale.**

**The Opportunity**

What we need now is someone to take what we've built and run with it. Not manage it \- **grow it**. From one part of Kolkata, to all of Kolkata, to West Bengal, to East India and beyond.

You'll report directly to the founders. No layers, no committees, no one to hide behind \- but also no one slowing you down. The Philippines playbook exists and you're welcome to use it but the decisions that matter will be yours to make.

**What You Will Own**

Full P\&L responsibility for the India business. Every dimension of it.

**Operations**

* Running and scaling warehouse and last\-mile delivery operations in Kolkata and beyond
* Managing a workforce that starts at \~50 people and will grow to several hundred as you scale
* Managing a trucking fleet to support deliveries
* Keeping operational discipline and unit economics intact as you expand

**Demand and Growth**

* Acquiring and retaining Kirana store customers across your geographies
* Building and managing the ground\-level team that makes this happen

**Commercial**

* Owning supplier relationships — mostly FMCG companies
* Building trade and visibility programs that generate revenue from those relationships

**People \& HR**

* Hiring and managing across levels — from warehouse staff and delivery executives to city managers and functional leads
* Building a culture that's lean, high\-ownership and performance\-driven without being bureaucratic

**Finance**

* Owning the India P\&L — revenues, costs, margins, working capital
* Working closely with the parent company's finance team on reporting, planning and controls

**Geographic Expansion**

* Executing the rollout from North Kolkata → full Kolkata → West Bengal → East India and beyond
* Each new geography means standing up a full operational, acquisition and procurement footprint — this is as much a logistics challenge as it is a commercial one

**Tech \& Product**

* Technology and product are built at the parent company level
* Your job is to localise, implement and feed ground\-level insight back into the India roadmap

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience \& Background**

* You've run a business, geography or large operational unit with **direct P\&L responsibility**. You know what it means to own a number, not just contribute to one
* You come from FMCG, grocery, quick commerce, B2B e\-commerce or supply chain \- companies like Blinkit, Zepto, Udaan, Jumbotail, Metro, or a large FMCG distributor are the kinds of backgrounds we're thinking about
* You've had **direct management responsibility for blue and grey collar workforces** \- warehouses, delivery fleets, field sales teams. This is not negotiable
* You're senior enough to set direction and willing to do the work yourself when the team needs it

**Skills \& Qualities**

* Operational rigour \- you build systems and processes, not just relationships
* Commercial acumen \- you understand margins, cost structures, customer economics and what drives a distribution business
* People leadership \- you attract strong people, develop them, and create accountability without layers
* You make decisions without waiting for perfect information or perfect resources
* You're motivated by the scale of what this could become, not just the safety of what it is today

**Preferred but not mandatory**

* Familiarity with the East India / Bengal market
* Bengali language skills
* Prior experience in an early\-stage or scaling environment

**Who we’re excited to hear from**

There is no single profile we're looking for. These are some types of people we think could be exceptional in this role.

**Former Entrepreneur**

You've built something in logistics, wholesale, grocery or e\-commerce. You know what it takes to start from zero and you're ready to do it again .. this time with institutional backing, an existing playbook and a large market in front of you.

**Senior Operator in Tech or Commerce**

You're a senior leader inside a logistics, e\-commerce, B2B or retail business. You've have strong instincts for what makes these models work and you're ready to run something yourself.

**FMCG Leader or Consultant**

You've spent years inside a regional or national FMCG company — in sales, distribution or trade — or advising them. You know the Kirana channel, you understand the distributor ecosystem, and you see the gap we're building into.

**The Career Path**

You're joining when the India business is small but the ambition is large. **If you scale this well**, the natural path is into a national leadership role — effectively Country Head for a business operating across India's major cities.

If your strengths turn out to be strongest in a particular domain or geography, there's also a real path as **Regional Head for East India** or as a **National Functional Leader** in Operations or Commercial — both of which will be substantial roles as the business grows.

The company will grow. The roles will grow. We will back the people who built it.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive fixed compensation benchmarked to your experience
* Performance\-linked variable pay tied to business outcomes
* **ESOPs** at the holding company level
* Direct access to and mentorship from the founding team
* The backing of a parent company with KKR, Temasek, IFC and other global institutional investors on the cap table

**Location**

**Kolkata, West Bengal.** Non\-negotiable for the immediate future. The business is here, the team is here, the customers are here. We need someone present, visible and embedded in this market from Day 1\.

**A Final Word**

We are not inviting you to manage something that exists. We are asking you to **build something that matters** — for a business category that employs more people in India than almost any other, but that modern commerce has mostly walked past.

Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. title: DWS Client Integration Architect
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**What success looks like in this role**

The **Digital Workplace Solutions Client Integration Architect** is responsible for ensuring seamless integration of Device Subscription Services (DSS) and Device\-as\-a\-Service (DaaS) into client environments, enabling a fully functional, end\-user device lifecycle experience.


This role bridges the gap between client IT ecosystems and Unisys DSS capabilities, ensuring that all required systems, processes, data flows, and governance models are successfully integrated. The architect ensures that DSS and DaaS operates as cohesive services across procurement, provisioning, asset management, financial management, support, and disposal.


Success in this role means:


* DSS is fully embedded into the client’s IT and business ecosystem with minimal friction
* All integration points (tools, data, workflows, suppliers) operate reliably and at scale
* Client\-specific requirements are translated into standardized, repeatable DSS integration patterns
* Implementation timelines are reduced through reuse of integration frameworks and accelerators
* Risks related to data, process, or tool misalignment are proactively mitigated
* Tools are accessed to ensure they are implemented using best in\-class solutions based on capabilities

**Key Responsibilities**

The DWS Client Integration Architect works closely with Solution Managers, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and Client stakeholders to design and implement integration models for DSS adoption.


**Integration Design \& Architecture**

* Define end\-to\-end **integration architecture** for DSS within client environments
* Map client systems (ITSM, HR, Finance, Procurement, Asset Management, Device Management) to DSS and DaaS processes
* Design **data flows, APIs, and system interfaces** required for DSS operations
* Establish integration patterns for:
	+ Order\-to\-provision workflows
	+ Asset and configuration data synchronization
	+ Incident, service request, and support processes
	+ Billing, chargeback, and financial tracking

**Client Environment Alignment**

* Assess client IT landscape, tooling, and process maturity
* Identify gaps between current state and DSS operating model
* Define required changes to client processes, policies, and governance
* Ensure DSS aligns with client compliance, security, and regulatory requirements

**Implementation \& Delivery Support**

* Support solutioning and deal phases with integration designs and effort estimates
* Work with delivery teams to ensure integration requirements are implemented correctly
* Define **integration runbooks, workflows, and operational procedures**
* Validate integration readiness prior to go\-live

**Standardization \& Reusability**

* Develop **standard integration blueprints and reference architecture** for DSS
* Create reusable assets such as:
	+ Integration patterns (API, batch, event\-driven)
	+ Data models and mapping templates
	+ Interface specifications and documentation
* Drive consistency across regions and clients

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Act as the primary integration interface between:
	+ Client IT and enterprise architecture teams
	+ Unisys solutioning and delivery teams
	+ OEMs, suppliers, and ecosystem partners
* Facilitate workshops to define integration requirements and solution approaches
* Translate complex integration topics into clear, business\-aligned language

**Governance \& Risk Management**

* Identify and mitigate integration risks early in the lifecycle
* Ensure proper data governance, ownership, and quality controls
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics for integration performance
* Support ongoing service improvements based on operational insights

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve DSS integration efficiency through:
	+ Automation
	+ API standardization
	+ Platform consolidation
* Incorporate lessons learned into future solution designs
* Support evolution of DSS integration capabilities aligned to market needs
* Drive cost\-effective DSS integration design and delivery
* Improve DSS effectiveness, deployment times, and maintenance by enabling AI capabilities

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

**Skills and Qualifications**

**Experience \& Knowledge**

* 5–10 years of experience in **IT architecture, system integration, or enterprise solutions**
* Strong experience with **ITSM, asset management, and enterprise platforms** (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Helix, SAP, etc.)
* Proven experience designing and implementing **system integrations and data flows**
* Experience in **device lifecycle or managed workplace services** preferred
* Understanding of **ITIL processes** (especially Service Design, Service Transition, and Service Integration)
* Experience in creating **high\-level design (HLD)** and **low\-level design (LLD)** documents and workflows

**Technical \& Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
	+ APIs, middleware, and integration technologies
	+ Data models, data mapping, and synchronization
	+ Workflow orchestration across multiple systems
* Ability to design **scalable and repeatable integration architectures**
* Familiar with automation, digital experience, and analytics platforms

**Consulting \& Communication**

* Strong client\-facing and workshop facilitation skills
* Ability to translate complex technical designs into clear business outcomes
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders
* Strong documentation and presentation skills

**Personal Attributes**

* Structured, detail\-oriented, and pragmatic
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to navigate ambiguity
* Collaborative and able to influence without direct authority
* Self\-driven and comfortable working in global, distributed teams
* Focused on standardization, scalability, and reusability

**Additional Expectations**

* Contribute to DSS playbooks, integration guides, and sales enablement materials
* Support pre\-sales and business development activities where integration is a critical component
* Stay current with emerging integration technologies, platforms, and industry trends
* Act as a thought leader in DSS integration strategy and best practices

About The LexSphere

The LexSphere is a pan\-India legal consultancy and educational platform offering corporate advisory, labour law compliance, HR architecture, contract drafting, legal notices, and legal education content. Operating across consultancy, content, and academic verticals, The LexSphere serves individual clients, corporate entities, HR professionals, and law aspirants. With a rapidly growing digital presence and an active in\-house team, we are looking for a sharp, organised, and proactive Office Coordinator to anchor our day\-to\-day operations.

Role Overview

The Office Coordinator will serve as the operational backbone of The LexSphere. This is not a passive administrative role \- the person in this position will be expected to manage communication pipelines, coordinate across multiple internal teams, maintain documentation discipline, and ensure that every client touchpoint, internal deadline, and institutional process runs without friction. You will work directly alongside the founding team and interface with our creative, content, and legal functions daily.

Key Responsibilities

**Client Coordination and Intake**

* Manage initial client communication across WhatsApp, email, and phone channels with a professional and responsive approach.
* Coordinate client onboarding, document collection, and appointment scheduling.
* Maintain a clean record of ongoing matters, follow\-up timelines, and client correspondence.
* Support the WhatsApp Broadcast and CRM pipeline by organising leads, tracking conversions, and flagging pending responses.

**Internal Team Coordination**

* Act as the coordination link between the legal team, content team, design function, and intern cohort.
* Liaise with the intern coordinator to track task assignments, submission deadlines, and intern performance records.
* Schedule and document team meetings, briefings, and review calls.
* Maintain a shared task tracker and ensure team deliverables are logged and followed up.

**Administrative and Documentation Management**

* Handle drafting, formatting, and dispatching of formal correspondence including legal notices, office communications, and client\-facing letters under supervision.
* Maintain physical and digital filing systems for client documents, contracts, compliance records, and institutional paperwork.
* Track office expenses, vendor invoices, and coordinate with accounts for timely payments.
* Support the preparation of presentations, proposals, and service catalogues as directed.

**Operations and Platform Support**

* Coordinate with the content team on scheduling, deadlines, and platform requirements for YouTube, Instagram, and WhatsApp content rollouts.
* Assist in managing institutional collaborations, event coordination, and external outreach logistics.
* Monitor and manage the general inbox and ensure no query goes unresponded within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain office supplies, vendor relationships, and general infrastructure functioning.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline (preference for Law, Commerce, or Management).
* Minimum one year of office coordination, administration, or legal office experience.
* Strong command over written and spoken Hindi and English \- Hinglish communication comfort is a plus.
* Working proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.
* Comfort with WhatsApp Business, basic email management, and digital file organisation.
* High attention to detail, particularly in documentation and correspondence.

Preferred Qualifications

* Background in or exposure to a law firm, legal consultancy, or compliance\-driven work environment.
* Familiarity with content or creator business operations.
* Experience handling multi\-channel client communication simultaneously.
* Basic understanding of labour law, POSH, or HR compliance terminology is an advantage \- not a requirement.

What We Offer

* A fast\-paced, high\-learning work environment at the intersection of law, content, and institutional building.
* Direct exposure to live corporate advisory, compliance, and legal education operations.
* Structured team culture with defined roles, clear accountability, and regular review.
* Growth opportunity into a senior operations or client management role as the platform scales.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

Who Should Apply

This role suits someone who takes ownership naturally, communicates clearly without being asked twice, and thrives in an environment where no two days look the same. If you are the person who notices what needs to be done before being told \- this is your role.

title: Technical Salesforce Specialist
description:
**Why join Thynk?**
-------------------


Founded by a team of experienced SaaS founders and hospitality executives, Thynk is on a mission to revolutionize the 2T$ hospitality industry and become a new vertical SaaS giant. Our ambition is fuelled by a fantastic product built on top of the Salesforce platform and a spot on time to market.


We raised a 13M$ Series A from high\-profile VCs (NY\+EU) to scale our operations and expand to the US. Your role is key at our stage to make sure we scale the right way, it is an opportunity to have a big impact on the company.


Our customers are all over the world and so are we, with team members from 25 nationalities, based on 3 continents and 6 time zones \- building a strong common culture while respecting the individual constraints of everyone in our remote\-first environment.


Thynk is also going through a deep AI transformation — we are rebuilding how our internal teams work, from sales to delivery, around AI tooling (Claude, Cowork, Code). Joining us today means being on the inside of that shift.

  

By joining the Thynk Team, you will recognize yourself in our values:

* **Ambition** \- We think big and act boldly. We’re organized to move fast, scale quickly and set industry standards.
* **Care** \- We believe in the power of being surrounded by a diverse international team of all\-stars, who are caring about each other and our customers. We prioritize balance and wellbeing.
* **Innovation** \- We look at the big picture to develop new solutions never done before. We believe in asking questions, challenging, and rarely taking no for an answer. We encourage our customers to do the same, and partner with them to bring forth this change.
* **Service** \- We develop services for people whose businesses are, above all, about quality of service. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and our technology is simply a means of helping them deliver exceptional service to their customers.

**About the role**
------------------


We are on a mission **to revolutionize the $2T hospitality industry** and to **become a new vertical SaaS giant**. As a rapidly growing SaaS company with high\-performance teams and a collaborative culture, this position is vital to Thynk’s success.

**Our Professional Services team is scaling alongside our US expansion**. We are hiring a Salesforce Specialist **based in India, working a US\-coverage shift**, to deliver hands\-on configuration and data work for our American customers — and to give our EU\-based PS team clean, same\-day hand\-offs.


You will join the Professional Services organization led by Nicolas Arfouilloux (VP Delivery \& CS), reporting directly to Maud, our SF Specialist Team Lead. You will **work alongside a fully remote team of Implementation Leads, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success Manager**, supporting customers from boutique hotel groups to global hospitality chains.

**Our product is a vertical SaaS suite built natively on the Salesforce Platform.** As a Salesforce Specialist you will work **hands\-on with the Thynk managed package across customer orgs — configuring modules, manipulating data, and supporting customers** and the internal team through every phase of implementation and post\-go\-live.

 **Your ramp\-up project: AI\-driven document migration**


Your first major mission will be a structural migration project for our customer base: moving from PDFButler custom template documents to the Thynk\-native e\-proposal and document generator. You will use Claude (Cowork and Code), our internal AI tooling, and lightweight scripting to parse legacy templates, map them to the new system, and re\-generate them at scale. This is high\-leverage, AI\-augmented work — and it sets the tone for how the rest of your role will look at Thynk.

**Beyond the ramp\-up, AI is now embedded in our way of working** — from configuration scaffolding to data inspection, from documentation to customer artifacts. You will be expected to use AI tooling daily, build small assistants and scripts as needed, and contribute to making our Professional Services team measurably faster.

**‍ As our Salesforce Specialist at Thynk, you will:**
------------------------------------------------------


Contribute as an individual contributor **in a strong, fully remote team and be a team player in a highly collaborative environment.** You will be responsible for:

* **Configuring the Thynk product on customer Salesforce orgs:** page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, custom fields and objects, record types, list views, Flow Builder automations, reports and dashboards — using Salesforce declarative tools.
* **Performing data manipulation and migration tasks:** data loading, cleansing, deduplication, and ETL of customer data via Data Loader, Workbench and similar tools; building SOQL queries to inspect, validate and report on records.
* **Driving AI\-augmented migrations and document workflows** — starting with the PDFButler Thynk e\-proposal \& document generator transition across customer accounts, using Claude (Cowork, Code) and scripting to parse, map, and regenerate templates at scale.
* **Building lightweight internal tooling and AI assistants to accelerate recurring PS work:** prompts, agents, small scripts, evaluation harnesses. Treat AI as a co\-worker, not a feature.
* **Supporting and running technical workshops, UAT cycles, and configuration reviews** with customers in English — bridging the gap between business requirements and Salesforce implementation.
* **Troubleshooting customer issues during implementation and post\-go\-live**, working closely with Implementation Leads, Customer Success Managers and the Engineering team.
* **Documenting configuration decisions, customer\-specific setups, and reusable AI prompts / scripts** in our internal knowledge base (Notion \+ Salesforce documentation).
* **Operating in a US\-shift schedule from India to give our American customers same\-day support** and to hand off cleanly to the EU\-based team each morning.
* **Continuously improving how we deliver:** spotting recurring patterns, productizing them with AI, and contributing to our PS playbook.

**About you**
-------------

**You will be a great fit if:**

* **You have 3 to 5 years of hands\-on Salesforce experience** (admin/configurator/consultant), with production work you can describe in detail.
* **You are Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM\-201\)** — or actively pursuing it. Platform App Builder is a plus.
* **You are fluent in Salesforce declarative tools**: Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets, page layouts, record types, custom objects, reports \& dashboards.
* **You can read Apex, understand triggers and SOQL queries, and debug from logs and error messages.**
* **You are comfortable with bulk data operations** (Data Loader, Workbench, SOQL) and you take data quality seriously.
* **You are AI\-curious and AI\-active:** you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot or similar in your daily work — or you are visibly eager to do so. You are comfortable writing prompts, iterating, evaluating outputs, and scripting around LLMs (Python, JS, or shell) to get useful work done.
* **You communicate clearly in English** (written and spoken) and can hold a technical conversation with a non\-technical customer.
* **You are based in India and willing to work shifted hours to cover US time zones** (typically \~4pm to 0am IST), 5 days a week, on a permanent basis.
* **You operate well in a remote, async, multi\-cultural environment.**

**Bonus points if you have:**

* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs:** writing agents, designing prompts at scale, evaluating outputs, or scripting AI workflows in production.
* Experience **implementing or supporting a Salesforce\-based ISV / managed package.**
* Experience with **document generation tools** (PDFButler, Conga, Docusign Gen, Nintex Drawloop, etc.) or **e\-signature platforms.**
* Exposure to the **hospitality, travel, or events industry.**
* **Familiarity with integrations:** Salesforce APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato, Zapier), or REST API consumption.
* **Advanced Salesforce certifications** (Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud).
* **Basic Apex or LWC development experience.**

***This job is made for you if you like:*** *getting hands deep into customer configurations, solving puzzles with data, treating AI as a power tool rather than a buzzword, and seeing the direct impact of your work on a customer going live. You enjoy a fast\-moving, no\-bureaucracy environment, and you like being the technical person customers trust when something needs to be figured out.*

***This job is not for you if you’re not:*** *comfortable owning your time and deliverables without micro\-management, ready to work shifted hours consistently, eager to learn a vertical (hospitality) that goes beyond just Salesforce, or sceptical that AI will be part of your daily toolkit.*

**What you can expect :**
-------------------------


We will provide **the best IT equipment** of your choice (Apple or Windows)


**We are remote\-first**: As a fully remote team of repeat entrepreneurs, we value communication, teamwork, and transparency above all.


**Global\-first**: You will join an international team with 21 nationalities on 3 continents : we organize monthly meetings and yearly events to gather all the team together. English is our first language .


**We are people\-first**: We care about our people (team members, clients, and partners), we value work\-life balance, and consider any request to achieve fullfillment at work.

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

* **Introduction call with Louise** (Global HR Lead \- 20 min)
* **1h technical fit interview with Maud** (SF Specialist Team Lead)
* **Take\-home practical test (\~1 hour)** — Salesforce configuration \+ small data manipulation exercise, with an explicit AI\-assistance component (you are encouraged to use Claude / your tool of choice and tell us how you used it).
* **30 min debrief on the practical test with Maud \+ one senior Tech team member**
* **Final interview with Nicolas Arfouilloux** (VP Delivery \& CS)

title: Manager, Technical Product Management - Product Owner or Manager

In this role, you will collaborate with cross\-functional delivery leads, analytics consultants, and data science teams to create innovative and advanced reporting solutions. * Use enterprise\-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement

* Remain current with industry trends to identify new or advanced solutions in Core HR reporting
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar field
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in a similar role as a Scrum Master, Software Development Project/Program Manager, Project/Program Manager, Data Engineer, Analytics Consultant, Data/Report Analyst, or HR Operations
* 2\+ years of experience with Agile tools, such as Swift, Rally, Jira, Nimble, or Aha!
* 2\+ years of experience with analytics tools such as Domo, Power BI, and Tableau
* Experience working in a matrixed and geographically distributed organization
* Experience of working with Global teams and handling people management responsibilities
* Experience leading large\-scale projects across multiple teams and departments
* Experience communicating technical decisions to audiences of varying size and technical depth
* Technical knowledge in People Analytics
* Current knowledge of industry trends including cloud\-based development, Agile development techniques, and project management
* Proven excellent problem solving and analytical abilities, including experience demonstrating data to inform decision making

* 3\+ years of experience developing products from ideation, through scoping and requirements gathering, to development, rollout, and maintenance
* Experience resolving and supervising software/product development initiatives

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. Requisition ID: 77662


**Job Description:****Description**



The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB’s IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip\-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed \& complex front\-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US.

  



As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad.

  



In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company.

  



We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast\-paced dynamic team environment.

**Responsibilities**



The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design.

  



Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:



* Recruiting \& Staffing:


* + Jointly drive staffing \& recruiting with HR to ensure a world\-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs.
* Technical Leadership:

	+ Act as the IC Verification \& Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front\-end modules

	+ Experience managing large technical teams

	+ A track record of growing successful design teams

	+ Ability to set \& articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those

	+ Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug\-tracking and reporting
* Communication:

	+ Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1:1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US.
* Travel to US will be required from time to time


**Required Experience and Skills**


* The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status \& schedule progress to senior management.


* Technical requirements:

	+ Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools

	+ Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content

	+ Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology

	+ Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification

	+ Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first\-pass success

	+ Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure

	+ Strong debug and root\-cause analysis skills
* Circuit Analysis:

	+ Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC \& DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op\-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge\-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e\-fuse and other supporting cells.

	+ Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning \& RF LNA design.

	+ Digital Design including SPI \& MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines.

	+ Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe.
**Minimum Requirements**


* BSEE; MS preferred


* 10\+ years of IC Design/Verification experience


* 6\+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience

description:

Job Description


Role: **Data Management Manager**

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Commercial Data Management Manager will be responsible for managing the execution of the Data Platforms Operations in partnership with the Technology team, driving continuous innovation, operational excellence, and cost efficiencies. The manager will oversee execution of features aligned with one or more of our Data Platform product teams and work with the global team and functional partners to implement additional capabilities to the platform aligned with business objectives. Also, the manager will partner with the Senior Manager, Data Platforms to initially focus on the transition efforts from the vendor teams, building a highly talented and data\-focused team in our Innovation Center in India. You will also be responsible for partnering with our Amgen Technology partners and peer teams in the US and India to plan, design and implement large and strategic Data enabling programs.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Execution of Data\-Enabling Features in Product Teams**

* Lead and oversee prioritization, execution and deployment of features in one of our Commercial Data Platforms Product teams aligned with standard operating procedures
* Lead various stages of SDLC as a member of the Data Management Operations teams – including requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders across the US Commercial Organization (including Incentive Compensation, Field Reporting, Forecasting, Secondary Analytics), design, testing and documentation in partnership with the Technology teams in a Product Team setting.
* Partner with peer teams in the US and technology teams to review requests, design solutions, estimate effort and prioritize requests in assigned Product backlog
* Communicate with stakeholders through various stages of the SDLC and ensure alignment with stakeholders, and management on effort, solution, timelines and expectations
* Accountable for ensuring governance processes are followed and appropriate system testing, User Accepting Testing (UAT) are done and documentation is set up to ensure traceability through the lifecycle of deployment
* Responsible for working with syndicated data sets including IQVIA data – DDD, Xponent, ELAAD, etc., Digital Marketing data sets including Patient and Physician level data sets and internal data sets like HR data, Call Activity data from CRM systems, Patient Hub data to set up and enable HCP \& Patient centric connected data sets for our stakeholders
* Build connected data products for Amgen’s Commercial Data and Analytics function leveraging data sets mentioned above that enable insights around Prescriber \& Patient behaviour \& engagement patterns to support more efficient targeting algorithms
* Manage the Big Data platform infrastructure (Built on AWS tech / Airflow for Data storage and orchestration and Databricks for processing) – including access to the platform, platform costs, ad hoc capabilities for users, data quality, etc.
* Partner with the US teams and Technology teams to evaluate and implement tools and technologies to support the future state of the platform including Automated Anomaly detection, Automated document generation, Bots against data, Searchability of data assets, LLM models on data and documents and other Gen AI capabilities
* Partner with the Technology teams and direct line management to implement processes to monitor system health, set up alerts for anomalies and implement steps to proactively remediate areas of concern on the infrastructure front
* Partner with peers across our four pillars – Master Data Management, Data Platforms, Patient Data Management, Data Acquisition \& Governance to ensure alignment on solutions implemented for stakeholders
* Identify and highlight roadblocks, process gaps, and resourcing needs to the Leadership team as part of continuous improvement efforts.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and highlight to direct line management and strategize roadmap for deployment

 **Manage Work Transition and Insourcing**

* In partnership with the Senior Manager Data Platforms, develop and oversee transition plans to migrate work to our Amgen India Innovation Center with minimal disruption and develop standard processes for onboarding peers and broader team.
* Execute on the insourcing of our Operational Data Management Services currently delivered by external vendors, ensuring appropriate knowledge transfer, risk mitigation, and operational readiness.
* Build robust repository of knowledge transition documents and set up processes for efficient operations within a global team framework

 **Facilitate Cross\-Team and Organizational Engagement and Alignment**

* Partner closely with peers in Commercial Data Strategy core pillars and Data Management Senior Manager to contribute to delivering against our priority initiatives and establish new ways of working, especially across time zones.
* Work with our Technology/IT partners and the US team members in Product Team setting and partner with other Product teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the Platform governance model
* Act as a liaison between at our Amgen India Innovation Center with other Customer Data \& Analytics Teams to ensure alignment on goals, processes, and success measures.

 **Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* any degree and 8 to 13 years of relevant data management experience
* Proven experience in working in global teams and across time zones and cultures
* Proven experience in working in Product teams and delivering high quality solution in adherence with established processes
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Excellent English oral and written communication.

 **Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Prior experience and success working in high\-performing data management teams, with clear demonstrations of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience leading and supporting Data Platforms Operations \- including executing in Agile Product teams, overseeing phased execution of Platform enhancements and innovations
* Prior experience in executing in major data transformation projects with global teams, including core teams located in India.
* Prior experience in data architecture and data flow design, data modelling and in data profiling
* Prior hands\-on experience and expertise in technologies such as AWS and Databricks with ability to dig into problem statements and partner with teams in Root cause analysis and in planning and implementing long term remediation
* Hands\-on experience with data analysis using tools and technologies like SQL, Python, R, etc.
* Prior experience in partnering with stakeholders and technology teams in solution design for small features as well as complex large programs
* Quick learning agility to understand new concepts such as our end\-to\-end Commercial data flows to identify and remediate interdependencies.
* Collaborate with peers, India leadership team and peer teams in the USA to stay ahead of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data acquisition and build multi\-year forward looking Data platform roadmaps.
* Alignment with best practices and a commitment to championing new and innovative methodologies and tools to enhance data strategies and solutions to drive business outcomes.

 **Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Experience working in the life sciences commercial data domain space, ideally in the areas of Data Platforms and Patient Data.
* Understanding of the syndicated commercial data sets and use cases
* Worked in multinational settings with teams from different countries.
* Basic understanding of compliance and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with and application of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

 **Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional collaboration and communication skills.
* Strong data \& analytics/critical\-thinking and decision\-making abilities.
* Able to perform well in a fast\-paced, changing environment.


Strong oral, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and controversial findings clearly and compellingly.

**Position Overview and Objective**

As a Manager for Governance, risk \& Compliance, information technology \& security GRC professional, with a great track record for managing the execution of GRC programs. Champions the customer’s right to privacy and security and build in those requirements into product offerings \& services as well as day\-to\-day business processes.


Helps Arctic Wolf implement and maintain a sustainable GRC program for the enterprise.

* Work with **multiple cross functional teams** to enhance and maintain a Unified Controls Framework that meets multiple regulatory/industry best practices security and privacy standards.

* Log, analyze, track and report on control related gaps/non\-conformities/findings and contextualize them for Risk Management purposes.

title: Contracts Manager
description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in team**
-----------------------------------

  

The Contracts Manager will be responsible for managing the full contract lifecycle, optimizing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and ensuring strong supplier and stakeholder alignment across categories. This role provides, commercial oversight, governance cadence management, and operational rigor, ensuring that contracting outcomes consistently deliver value, mitigate risk, and support category and business strategies. Work closely with, internal stakeholders, Legal, and Supply partners to drive performance, streamline contracting processes, and ensure high\-quality execution across pre award, award, and post award contract lifecycle stages.

  

Job will be based at Bangalore, Whitefield office ( WFO) for 5 days in a week.

**What you will do**
--------------------

  



**Key Responsibilities**

  

1\. **Commercial Delivery \& Quality Assurance**

* Oversee and review all major negotiations to ensure commercial excellence.
* Validate pricing structures, terms \& conditions, performance metrics, service levels, and risk allocation.
* Ensure agreements fully reflect business needs, category guidance, and global procurement standards.
* Support development of negotiation strategies, bid evaluations, and award recommendations.

 **2\. Contract Lifecycle Ownership \& Governance**

* Ensure full contract lifecycle in alignment with corporate procedures (Requisition\-to\-Pay, MOC, stewardship).
* Maintain governance over scopes, pricing updates, exhibits, amendments, and supplier performance mechanisms.
* Oversee contract compliance and ensure supplier performance monitoring, issue resolution, and utilization tracking.
* Support standardization and efficiency of contracting processes, tools, and templates.

 **3\. Category Strategy \& Business Alignment**

* Partner with Category Managers to translate category strategy into contracting plans and execution roadmaps.
* Align team activities with Category commercial and strategic guidance, market intelligence, and risk outlook.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate demand, optimize contracting models, and enhance value across categories.
* Provide commercial insights to drive cost avoidance, cost mitigation, and lifecycle value.

 **4\. Supplier Relationship \& Performance Oversight**

* Ensure strong supplier engagement and drives value in negotiations and performance management.
* Provide escalation support for supplier issues, performance gaps, stewardship, or commercial disputes.
* Ensure actively track performance trends and utilize insights to inform contract changes or renewals.

 **5\. Risk Management \& Compliance**

security across the enterprise and protect Saviynt's data assets in an AI\-driven and cloud\-first environment

* Design, deploy, and continuously improve enterprise DLP solutions across endpoints, email, cloud environments, and enterprise SaaS applications. Own tooling, policy tuning, incident response workflows, and effectiveness reporting to senior leadership
* Develop and enforce data classification policies, data handling standards, and acceptable use guidelines for generative AI and third\-party services, aligned with regulatory requirements (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001\)
* Conduct data flow mapping, risk assessments, and third\-party data handling reviews to identify how Saviynt's internal and customer data is collected, processed, stored, and transmitted and ensure remediation of exposure gaps across the data lifecycle
* Own the DSPM program to continuously discover, classify, and monitor sensitive data across cloud environments and AI and SaaS applications. Drive remediation of misconfigurations, shadow data, unprotected storage, and over\-privileged access
* Integrate DSPM insights with broader security operations to maintain a unified data risk posture, and define data access policies in partnership with IAM/IGA teams to enforce least\-privilege principles
* Provide cloud security architecture guidance across multi\-cloud environments (AWS,Azure, GCP) covering IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS; conduct security assessments of externally consumed SaaS applications, AI applications and internally deployed workloads to evaluate architectural risks and data security control gaps
* Define and drive the enterprise AI Security and Governance strategy, establishing policies, risk frameworks, and controls for the secure and responsible adoption of AIte chnologies and platforms including generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and third\-party AI based SaaS services.


* Conduct AI security assessments evaluating risks while ensuring alignment with emerging frameworks and regulations (OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\).

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent work experience with demonstrated results.
* 10\+ years of experience in working in the information security space.

* In\-depth knowledge of AWS, Azure or GCP Cloud Platform with strong understanding of security principles, standards, and frameworks (e.g., NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR,ISO 42001\) as applied to cloud environments.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with


cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

* Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):

  

\> Data Classification, Retention \& Handling Policy
\> Incident Response Policy/Procedures
\> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures
\> Mobile Device Policy
\> Account Management Policy
\> Access Control Policy
\> Personnel Security Policy
\> Privacy Policy

* Identify opportunities for automation, process efficiency, and user experience improvements
* Support transformation programs, upgrades, and cloud HR initiatives
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and innovation

* Payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types

* Time and benefits integration
* Payroll posting and finance integration
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-country payroll environments

* Solid understanding of:
* Integrations (SAP Integration Suite / CPI, APIs)

* Ability to translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions

* Managed incident, problem, and change management processes at scale
* Experience in implementations, rollouts, and transformation programs
* Strong understanding of service management frameworks (ITIL preferred)

* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business leaders

* Input and maintain member data across designated pension administration systems.

* Check own work carefully and escalate discrepancies or unclear cases to senior colleagues.

title: Doctor
description:
At **DGVS**, we believe that quality healthcare is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is to bridge the gap between medical resources and underserved communities. Through our **Mobile Medical Van Initiative**, we take the hospital directly to the doorsteps of those who need it most—bringing healing, comfort, and free medication to diverse locations every single day.

We are seeking a compassionate, resilient, and dedicated medical professional to lead our mobile clinic and make a tangible difference on the front lines of community health.

**Position Overview**

As a **Mobile Medical Van Doctor**, you will be the face of DGVS’s healthcare outreach. This is not a typical desk job. Every day, you will travel to different communities, setup a mobile clinic, diagnose patients who often have limited access to healthcare, and provide them with essential treatments and medications.

If you are driven by purpose, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to use your medical skills for pure humanitarian impact, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Mobile Patient Care:** Conduct daily OPD consultations inside and alongside the mobile van at various designated locations.
* **Diagnosis \& Treatment:** Diagnose and treat acute and chronic illnesses across diverse age groups (pediatric to geriatric).
* **Medication Distribution:** Screen, prescribe, and oversee the dispensing of free medicines from the van’s inventory.
* **Community Health Education:** Guidance on hygiene, nutrition, and preventive healthcare to empower local communities.
* **Emergency Response:** Provide primary stabilization and refer severe cases to nearby secondary or tertiary hospitals when necessary.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with the van driver, support staff, and local community volunteers to ensure smooth operations.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Qualifications:** Valid MBBS degree with a current registration with the Medical Council.
* **Experience:** Prior experience in general practice, emergency medicine, or community health is preferred, but passionate freshers dedicated to charity work are welcome.
* **Skills:** Strong diagnostic skills with limited resources, adaptability, and excellent communication.
* **Heart for Service:** Deep empathy, patience, and a non\-judgmental attitude toward vulnerable or marginalized populations.
* **Language:** Fluency in the local language(s) of the region is highly desirable to connect effectively with patients.

**Job Perks \& Work Environment**

* **Impact:** The unmatched satisfaction of serving those who genuinely need your help.
* **Dynamic Setting:** No two days are the same; you will experience the rich diversity of different communities daily.
* **Schedule:** Day shifts only (No night shifts or on\-call emergencies).
* **Support:** You will be accompanied by a dedicated team (driver/coordinator and a pharmacist/nurse) to assist you with logistics and medicine dispensing.
* **Compensation:** A competitive honorarium/salary aligned with NGO standards, along with travel provisions.

"The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others."If your passion for medicine goes beyond the walls of a traditional hospital, join DGVS in driving change—one village, one slum, and one patient at a time.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading a team, comprising of freshers, front end, back end, data management, security, marketing, and sales to drive innovation in full\-stack product development, while relentlessly improving performance, scalability, and maintainability.

  

Portal Product Development, Maintenance, and Management: This is a variant of our core SAAS portal; VWork247, which is a generic work manager, however, this variant is modeled specifically for Real Estate rehabbers in North America. Our core is an integrated software so the user gets several utilities such as CRM, Project Management, Accounting, HR, office productivity tools, and mobile phone integration, all in one subscription at a very low price of US$30 per month. Rehabbers are specialized contractors/developers who deal with old structures to be renewed. There are about ten competitors in this space, but none has an integrated product like ours. The market for software sales in this segment is about US$1 billion per year. We expect to extract about US$10 million per year from this pool. You will be the creator and executor of the product development plan, discussing needs with all stakeholders.

  

Induction From Base To Top Lead: You will be inducted into the group, to be groomed and given a chance to learn the ropes from the ground, so that you can reach the top. The ownership shall provide you full support that is needed to learn the skills needed for the multi\-roles to rise through the ranks, executing while learning and delivering the results. This is a unique position that may need some hand\-holding but mostly your zeal and conviction to reach full charge. This position is not for the timid or the laid\-back person, as grueling hours are needed. You must be a natural passionate leader, analyzer, implementer, and aspire to be the best that there is, bar none. A very organized person with an eye on learning new skill sets are absolutely essential.

  

Technical Guidance: You will provide entire technical expertise; which requires that you have the technical depth to make complex design decisions and the hands\-on ability to lead by example.

  

Execution and Delivery: You will be expected to instill and follow good software development practices and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products. You should be familiar with agile practices, as well as be able to adapt these to the needs of the business, with a constant focus on product quality and market share.

  

Technical Guidance: You will provide entire technical expertise; which requires that you have the technical depth to make complex design decisions and the hands\-on ability to lead by example.

  

Profit\-Sharing: The principal component of your compensation is derived from the sales. We have assigned a very liberal portion of the gross revenue/profits. Our accounting is very transparent. Our product is SAAS at this time. There are no cash sales. We expect to reach at least about 1000 subscribers at US$30\.00 per month in less than a year after launch. If you reach the top to lead this group, you will get 0\.25% of this sale revenue, otherwise, if you are in the group as a member\-only, you will get 0\.025%. We measure your performance in milestones that are pre\-assigned to you.

Organization: Johan Brown Publishing Pvt. Ltd.  
Location: Hyderabad  
Department: Student Wellness \& Mental Health Program  
Role Type: On\-site.  
Duration: 3–6 months

About Johan Brown Publishing Pvt Ltd

At Johan Brown Publishing, we are pioneering the world of SMART eBooks and digital innovation, blending technology with creativity to deliver impactful learning and entertainment experiences. Alongside our award\-winning projects like SAATH, KATHA, and O’WOW, we are equally committed to building a strong, people\-centric workplace that fosters growth, inclusivity, and collaboration.

About the Role

We are seeking a **Psychologist Intern** to support the on\-ground and programmatic implementation of **SAATH**, a mental wellness initiative designed in response to the growing need for preventive mental health systems in educational institutions.

The intern will work closely with psychologists, program coordinators, and school/college stakeholders to assist in:

· wellness screening \& documentation,

· psychoeducation delivery,

· referral pathways,

· training support for staff,

· and rollout of SAATH\-aligned wellbeing tools.

This internship is ideal for students/recent graduates looking for real\-world exposure in **developmental mental health, school psychology, preventive counselling systems, and mental health program implementation.**

Key Responsibilities

1\) SAATH Program Implementation Support

· Assist in implementation of the **SAATH framework:**  
**Support, Awareness, Acceptance, Therapy \& Healing**.

· Support onboarding and engagement of partner institutions (schools / colleges).

· Coordinate with internal teams for roll\-out of digital/structured wellness resources (“Therapedia” ecosystem).

2\) Student Wellness Support \& Documentation

· Assist in basic screening, intake, and mental wellness documentation (under supervision).

· Support safe and confidential workflows for identifying students at risk.

· Help maintain anonymized datasets, case logs, and program dashboards (non\-clinical only unless authorized).

3\) Psychoeducation \& Awareness Activities

· Support delivery of **awareness sessions** for students/teachers/parents (stress, anxiety, exam pressure, bullying, emotional regulation etc.).

· Contribute to creating stigma\-free messaging that frames help\-seeking as a strength and right.

4\) Teacher \& Stakeholder Support

· Assist in training facilitation support for teachers/staff (recognizing signs, escalation steps, early intervention).

· Support building institution\-level wellbeing workflows aligned with Supreme Court expectations for institutional responsibility.

5\) Reporting \& Program Evaluation

· Support monitoring impact indicators (reach, sessions conducted, referrals, engagement, feedback).

· Assist in compiling reports/presentations for leadership and partner institutions.

· Contribute insights for improving tool usability and adoption.

6\) Safe Zone Administration \& Student Support

· Assist in the implementation and administration of Safe Zone wellbeing systems across partner institutions.

· Support confidential student support workflows, ensuring safe, inclusive, and stigma\-free access to mental health resources.

· Coordinate with psychologists, counsellors, teachers, and institutional stakeholders to facilitate timely interventions and referral pathways.

· Contribute to Safe Zone awareness initiatives, peer\-support activities, and wellbeing campaigns that strengthen the institution's culture of care and psychological safety.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong foundation in **psychology principles**, developmental psychology, basic counselling skills.
* Excellent communication (English \+ regional language is a plus).
* Comfort working with young adults and school systems.
* High ethical standards: confidentiality, consent, sensitivity.
* Ability to write documentation clearly and objectively.
* Interest in preventive mental health \& scalable wellness programs.

Eligibility Criteria

* Students / freshers pursuing or completed:
* BA/BSc Psychology
* MA/MSc Psychology
* Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology (preferred)
* Applied Psychology / School Psychology
* Must be available for internship duration (typically 3–6 months)

Benefits

· **Internship Stipend:** ₹8,000 per month.

· **Internship Certificate** upon successful completion.

· Potential to convert the internship into **full\-time employment**, with a **salary** based on performance and demonstrated capabilities.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 per month
