description:
**Job Advertisement – Junior Production Engineer (Location: Vasai)**  
**Company Description:** SynThera Biomedical Pvt. Ltd. is an advanced materials startup focusing on R\&D, manufacture and commercialization of high\-purity specialty glass and advanced ceramics products for high tech sectors such as healthcare and electronics. The company has a rapidly growing technology portfolio (5 patents granted – 2 Indian and 3 International); 2 peer\-reviewed academic papers in international journals out of which it has conceptualized multiple products that are all the first of their kind to be developed in India. In fact, our patented/proprietary products are the first to be developed globally. These products are at different technology readiness levels and continuous work is ongoing to bring the most developed products to market by expanding our capabilities in manufacturing, marketing and sales. The Company is the recipient of multiple awards for its innovative work and enjoys a strong and rapidly expanding network of partners in industry and academia both within India and internationally. The core values of the company are encapsulated in its QAI philosophy: **Quality – Affordability – Innovation.**

**Job Summary:** As a Junior Production Engineer, you will have exciting opportunities to apply your technical knowledge in the manufacturing of the Company’s patented and off\-patent material products in the glass and ceramics domains. You will get to work with team members and stakeholders having diverse competencies in R\&D, quality control, and supply chain with considerable scope for cross\-functional training. At all levels, suggestions for improvement of existing manufacturing systems and processes will be encouraged. Your focus on precision and ability to meet production targets will help in completing critical deliverables. Your innovative approach to process optimization will facilitate in scaling complex technologies from lab\-scale to commercial production. The production outcomes supervised by you will have a major bearing on the future scalability and commercial success of the Company.

Key Responsibilities:

· **Manufacturing Operations:** Assisting in the day\-to\-day production of specialty glass and advanced ceramics, focusing on furnace operations and material synthesis.

· **Utility \& Systems Management:** Basic oversight and handling of critical production utilities including gas units (Oxygen/Argon), cooling systems, and specialized industrial units.

· **Process Monitoring:** Monitoring electrical parameters, including current and voltage stability, to ensure consistent heating and material processing.

· **Equipment Handling:** Operating production\-oriented machinery and applying basic principles of physics (thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and stress\-strain) to troubleshoot minor mechanical issues.

· **Technical Calculations:** Applying knowledge of physics units and conversion factors (pressure, temperature, flow rates) to ensure precise batch processing.

· **Quality \& Compliance:** Ensuring strict adherence to Quality Management Systems (QMS) and maintaining detailed production logs.

· **Reporting:** Reporting of Production Performance Metrics and utility consumption to Top Management.

Candidate Profile:

**Qualification:**

· **Degree/Diploma:** BE, BTech, or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, and Chemical Engineering.

· **Fresher Friendly:** This position is open to fresher’s or recent graduates who have a strong grasp of engineering fundamentals.

Essential Technical Knowledge:

· **Electrical Units:** Clear idea of current, voltage, and electrical units required for industrial equipment operation.

· **Gas \& Utility Systems:** Basic understanding of gas units (Oxygen, Argon, etc.), oxygen units, and industrial cooling/chiller units.

· **Applied Physics:** Strong foundational knowledge of physics units and a production\-oriented understanding of how machines work based on physical laws.

· **General Skills:** Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and proficiency in MS Office (Excel).

**Who can apply:** Only those candidates can apply who:

1\. Are available for full\-time (in\-office/on\-site) role in **Vasai**.

2\. Can start the job immediately.

3\. Are willing to work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment involving high\-temperature equipment.

4\. **Local candidates from Vasai will be preferred.**

5\. **Candidates applying from outside Vasai will be responsible for their own accommodation and travel arrangements.**

**Women wanting to start/restart their career are encouraged to apply.**

**Stipend/Salary:** Will be decided based on candidate profile and performance during interview.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

description:

Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. * Guide the team to excel in all performance parameters which include cost management, key process performance indicators (TAT, accuracy etc.), customer satisfaction levels etc.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Implement the group compliance policy as applicable to his role. Should be aware of the Operational Risk scenarios associated with their role, and to ensure that all actions during their employment with HSBC, take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring.
* Monitoring \& assessment of performance of reporting staff with the help of Production management systems
* Setting discipline for routine activities. Leading of example and ensuring deadlines are met.

 **Impact on the Business:**

  

* Ensure that there is improvement in productivity for transaction processing and service delivery.
* Conduct User Acceptance Tests (UAT)
* Ensure all the policies and procedures are being adhered scrupulously.
* Ensure all payment operations activities are performed smoothly and that deadlines are met.
* Vendor management and Co\-ordination.
* Cost Management.

 **Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* Contributes to building good customer relations and maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Understand and implement customer requirements. Ensure highest level of engagement with business groups and IT.
* Identify training needs and ensure training requirements are met.
* Manage the operational risk associated with the role and safeguard the interest of the bank.
* Ensures audit recommendations / Compliance issues.
* Reporting / Preparation of returns.
* Business Continuity Plan (BCP)

 **Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
* **Experience:** 3\-5 years of experience in Operations is preferrable. Freshers can apply.
* **Skills:** Strong understanding of payment processing systems, excellent analytical, problem\-solving skills and customer centric approach to support Business growth.

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: HR Operations Team Lead - ELC
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


HR Operations Delivery Manager \- ELC  

HR Operations Team Lead – Employee Lifecycle (ELC)


Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ\+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.  

  

You will be working as HR Operations Team Lead – ELC and reporting to the Hub Delivery Manager – ELC, HR Operations, based in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will be leading a team of 10\+ members across multiple clusters and will take full accountability for the end\-to\-end Employee Lifecycle Management (ELC) process, delivering high\-quality services against globally agreed performance targets. You will ensure a high degree of customer experience by committing to complete, accurate, and timely completion of HR transactions. You will support the globally set standards for HR Operations and ensure that local legal and regulatory requirements — including country specific laws and compliance — are adhered to within the HR Operations Hub processes.

**Your Responsibilities**
=========================

* Driving the end\-to\-end HR Operations across one or more Countries and/or Service Lines, with oversight of multiple clusters and direct supervision of Junior Team Leads and their respective reporting teams.
* Delivering HR services according to signed\-off processes, KPI and quality targets in a timely and accurate manner, covering the full spectrum of Employee Lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, job changes, and other HR transactions.
* Leading and managing a team of 10\+ members, allocating work effectively across clusters, building team capability, and ensuring adequate backup strength and business continuity for key roles.
* Handling tough conversations, managing performance discussions, and driving accountability across direct and indirect reports. Supporting Junior Team Leads in addressing team\-level performance and development needs.
* Taking ownership of escalations — driving timely resolutions, communicating proactively with stakeholders, and implementing preventive measures to avoid recurrence.
* Ensuring compliance with India labor laws, local regulatory requirements, GDPR, and internal control standards in all HR transactions, in collaboration with the HR Front Office Manager, across HROS service lines, HRBP’s, Line Managers, COE’s.
* To be able to create impact through greater productivity, exploration, and continuous self\-development using AI technology.
* Driving a high degree of customer orientation and a proactive 'can\-do attitude'. Analyzing customer feedback and taking corrective and improvement actions to enhance the Customer Experience Journey.
* Supporting cross\-collaboration within HR Operations and other HR functions to optimize processes and tools, promoting synergies across functions.
* Supporting the Hub Delivery Manager in implementing global initiatives such as acquisitions, divestments, new policies, and change programs within the respective team(s).
* Continuously analyzing and optimizing operational performance across the team — managing training, knowledge transfer, quality checks, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Setting clear targets and managing performance for direct reports. Proactively growing the capability of the team, encouraging open development discussions and leading with the required cultural sensitivity.

**Your Background**
===================

* Bachelor's degree in any stream; a postgraduate degree or MBA in HR is preferred.
* Minimum 8 to 10\+ years of experience in HR Shared Services / HR Operations in a global organization.
* Minimum 5\+ years of people management experience, including managing Team Leads or senior individual contributors.
* Proven experience managing a team size of 10\+ members across multiple clusters or geographies.

title: Fresher Hardware Engineer (Embedded Systems & Robotics)
description:
**About the Role :**  
We are building low\-cost, practical robotics and IoT hardware products for real\-world use. As our Hardware Engineer , you will take full ownership of designing, prototyping, and scaling embedded hardware solutions from idea to production. You will work hands\-on with microcontrollers like ESP32 and Arduino to create reliable, affordable products that include sensors, wireless connectivity, actuators, and power\-efficient designs.

This is a high\-impact role where your college projects will directly translate into real products. You will help us keep hardware costs minimal while delivering functional, production\-ready robotics and IoT devices.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
\- Design, prototype, and iterate on embedded hardware products using ESP32, Arduino, and similar microcontrollers.  
\- Develop and optimize firmware for features such as sensor integration, wireless communication (Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth), data logging, actuator control, and configurable operation.  
\- Create and refine custom PCB designs with focus on low BOM cost and easy manufacturing.  
\- Integrate various components (sensors, cameras, motors, power modules, etc.) into complete robotics/IoT systems.  
\- Implement power optimization techniques (deep sleep, battery/solar compatibility) for efficient, long\-running devices.  
\- Test, debug, and improve hardware reliability, including Wi\-Fi stability, environmental testing, and enclosure design.  
\- Collaborate with backend/software teams to ensure smooth data transmission and cloud/IoT integration.  
\- Prepare BOMs, documentation, and support small\-batch production and scaling to higher volumes.

**Must\-Have Requirements :**  
\- Proven College Project Experience (Mandatory): You must have already built and demonstrated working hardware projects during college using ESP32 or Arduino for example, robotics prototypes, IoT devices with sensors/actuators, wireless data transmission, or any similar embedded system.  
\- Strong hands\-on expertise in:  
\- ESP32 and Arduino platforms (programming, peripherals, Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth)  
\- Firmware development (Arduino IDE or ESP\-IDF)  
\- Basic electronics, soldering, prototyping, and troubleshooting  
\- Basic knowledge of PCB design tools (KiCad / EasyEDA) and component sourcing.  
\- Passion for building cheap, reliable, and practical hardware products from scratch.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills :**  
\- Experience with custom PCB fabrication services (JLCPCB/PCBWay) and cost optimization.  
\- Familiarity with sensors, motors, cameras, or other robotics components.  
\- Basic Python scripting for testing or automation.  
\- Knowledge of 3D printing or enclosure design for prototypes.

**What We Offer :**  
\- End\-to\-end ownership of hardware products right from Day 1\.  
\- Real exposure to production scaling (prototype → 100–1000\+ units).  
\- Competitive fresher salary \+ performance bonus.  
\- Fast learning curve in embedded hardware, robotics, and IoT product development.  
\- Flexible work environment with room to experiment and innovate.

If you have already built and showcased ESP32 or Arduino\-based hardware projects in college, this role is perfect for you.

* Design modern, visually balanced, and user\-friendly interfaces.
* Review implemented designs and support QA to ensure design accuracy during development.


**Mobile\-First UI Design**
* Design intuitive and responsive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.
* Follow platform guidelines such as Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design.
* Create adaptive layouts for mobile phones, tablets, and different screen sizes.
* Maintain usability, visual consistency, and accessibility across platforms.


**High\-Fidelity Visual Design**

* Create visually rich layouts with strong design fundamentals, including typography, spacing, grids, color systems, and visual hierarchy.
* Use Adobe Photoshop for advanced visual assets, editing, masking, and compositing.

* Build interactive prototypes to demonstrate user flows and screen transitions.

* Good knowledge of usability principles and user\-centered design.

* Understanding of responsive design principles.

* Experience in design handoff and developer collaboration.


**Nice to Have**

* Ability to blend modern UI design with cultural, traditional, or regional aesthetics.
* Exposure to scalable design systems, component libraries, and UI documentation.

 Join us as a "Business Analyst" at Barclays, where you'll support the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll ready our processes to harness technology and improve customer experience. You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with process optimisation, data analysis, and problem solving.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Business Analyst, as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as a "Business Analyst", you should have experience with:
   

  

**Basic / Essential Qualifications**
* Strong business analysis experience, including requirements gathering, process mapping and translating business needs into actionable outcomes.
* Proven experience in process improvement and optimisation, identifying inefficiencies and driving standardisation to improve consistency and control.
* Hands\-on experience with automation and digital tooling (e.g. workflow automation, data analysis tools, or low\-code platforms) aligned to continuous improvement objectives.
* Prior process and task automation experience (robotics, workflow, BPM, document processing, AI enabled automation).
* Ability to spot inefficiencies, manual touchpoints, and opportunities for automation or standardisation.
* Monitor automation solution performance to identify opportunities for optimization that meets the banks performance standards.
* Define and track KPIs related to automation effectiveness, uptime, throughput, and ROI.
* Develop process and task automation business cases, ROI models and value realization frameworks for automation initiatives.
* A proactive problem solver, who can work under their own initiative.


**Desirable Skillsets / Good To Have**
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments, partnering with Product Owners, engineers and stakeholders to shape and deliver change.
* Knowledge of data analytics and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, SQL, Excel advanced analytics) to support insight\-led decision making.
* Experience in financial services / Transaction Banking, including understanding of operational processes, controls, and regulatory considerations.
* Familiarity with UiPath or any other RPA tool would be a plus.
* Experience in process mapping using Blueworks or similar tools.


 The location is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**About DecisionX** 




  





 DecisionX is building the operating system for modern decision\-making teams. We work closely with strategy, consulting, analytics, and business leadership teams to help them move faster and make better decisions through AI\-native workflows.
 



 We are an early\-stage startup, which means high ownership, fast execution, and a steep learning curve. If you enjoy building from scratch, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with founders, this role is for you.
 



  





**Role: HR Intern** 




 Location: Bangalore (preferred) / Hybrid
 



 Duration: 3 Months ; converting to full time offer based on performance
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





**What You’ll Work On** 




 This is not a traditional HR internship. You’ll work across both:
 


1. Talent Hiring \& Recruiting
2. People Operations \& Culture Building



 You’ll directly work with the founders and help shape the team during the company’s early growth phase.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**A) Hiring \& Talent Acquisition** 



* Source high\-quality candidates across internships and full\-time roles
* Write and improve job descriptions
* Manage inbound applications and candidate pipelines
* Conduct initial screening calls and candidate coordination
* Help improve employer branding and candidate communication
* Maintain hiring trackers, interview feedback, and hiring analytics
* Experiment with unconventional sourcing strategies (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, campus outreach, etc.)
* Improve candidate experience across the hiring funnel



  





**B) People \& Process** 



* Help build onboarding and employee experience processes
* Create internal HR documentation and SOPs
* Support performance review and feedback systems
* Help organize team rituals, culture initiatives, and engagement activities
* Improve operational workflows across hiring and people management
* Work on HR automation using AI and no\-code tools wherever possible
* Coordinate across teams to ensure smooth communication and execution



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




 We care more about ownership, judgement, and execution than formal HR experience.
 



 You may be a strong fit if you:
 



  




* Are highly organised and proactive
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Have strong people judgement and observation skills
* Enjoy speaking to candidates and building relationships
* Can handle ambiguity and move fast
* Are comfortable using AI tools, spreadsheets, and productivity software
* Have strong attention to detail
* Are curious about startups and company building



  





**Bonus Points If You:** 



* Have prior internship experience in HR, recruiting, operations, or community building
* Have worked in startup environments
* Enjoy process design and systems thinking
* Have experience with LinkedIn sourcing or campus hiring



  





**What You’ll Learn** 



* End\-to\-end startup hiring
* How high\-performing teams are built
* Founder\-level decision making
* Startup operations and people systems
* AI\-first workflows for recruiting and operations
* Communication, stakeholder management, and execution



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 By the end of the internship, you would have:
 


* Helped close strong hires
* Improved at least one core HR or hiring process
* Built systems that scale with the company
* Taken ownership of real operational problems

title: HR Interns
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Intern with a strong interest in Indian Labour Law and Compliance Implementation. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between statutory requirements and daily HR operations. You will support the HR department in auditing existing practices, drafting compliant policies, and ensuring our organization adheres to the latest Central and State\-specific labor regulations in India.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student or recent graduate pursuing an MBA in HR, a Master’s in Labour Studies (MLS), or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) to gain hands\-on experience in a corporate compliance environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Statutory Research \& Monitoring


 Conduct research on the four new Labour Codes (Wage, Social Security, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety) and their phased implementation.
   

  

 Track updates regarding state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and Professional Tax requirements.
   

  

 Assist in mapping Central and State\-specific compliance requirements to internal HR processes.
   

  

* Policy Drafting \& Indian Compliance


 Assist in updating the Employee Handbook to ensure compliance with the Standing Orders Act and local leave policies.
   

  

 Support the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Committee with administrative tasks, awareness posters, and documentation of training sessions.
   

  

 Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for grievance redressal as per the Industrial Disputes Act.
   

  

* Compliance Auditing \& Payroll Support


 Perform audits of employee files to ensure mandatory documentation (Aadhaar, UAN, PAN, nomination forms) is complete.
   

  

 Review job descriptions to ensure alignment with Code on Wages definitions (e.g., distinguishing between 'Worker' and 'Employee' categories).
   

  

 Assist with "Statutory Health Checks" including EPF, ESI, and Gratuity record\-keeping.
   

  

* Training \& Education


 Help design internal training materials for managers on the POSH Act and the Maternity Benefit Act.
   

  

 Prepare FAQs on Indian tax deductions (TDS) and social security benefits to help employees understand their pay slips.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Onboarding


 Support the HR team in drafting offer letters and employment contracts that comply with the latest Indian judicial precedents.
   

  

 Ensure all exit formalities align with statutory requirements for full and final (F\&F) settlements.
   

  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master of Labour Studies (MLS), or LLB.
   

  

 Legal Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Indian Labour Laws (e.g., Factories Act, EPF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, and Payment of Bonus Act).
   

  

 Attention to Detail: High level of precision in reviewing statutory registers and employee records.
   

  

 Confidentiality: Absolute discretion in handling sensitive employee data and PII (Personally Identifiable Information).
   

  

 Communication: Strong writing skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage for interpreting local state rules.
   

  

 Learning Objectives
   

  

 By the end of this internship, the candidate will have:
   

  

 Developed a practical understanding of how Indian Labour Laws translate into corporate policy.
   

  

 Gained experience in risk mitigation, statutory filing processes, and HR auditing.
   

  

 Built a portfolio of drafted policies and compliance communication materials.
   

  

 Learned the complexities of managing compliance across different Indian states.

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Duties \& Responsibilities :** Account Lead
  
  

* Account Lead will have responsibility for the management of a wide range of issues, from


strategic contracts management to input on day\-to\-day operations. This position needs to
  
be highly familiar with the service structure, including responses to requests
  
for assistance on Facilities Management issues from client staff and
  
arrangements pertaining to all operating expenditures. This position will form a part of
  
the team that will provide a professional, value\-focused service aimed at meeting or
  
exceeding the client’s expectations.
  
  

* Lead the JLL management and Site team in the delivery of facility management services.
* Coordinate with all city SPOCs towards efficiently carry out the tasks assigned as per the contract.
* Ensure that the services are delivered in line with the contractual commitments and


within budgets.

delivery of various Contracts being managed by JLL

* Develop a Service Level Agreements and assist the Jones Lang LaSalle procurement

vendors.

resources.

define the mechanism to assess the performance levels of various subcontractors.
  
* Ensure that all the Key performance indicators are achieved as per the contract
* Control and supervise the transport operations for the account.
* Assess performance of the subcontractors based on performance assessment criteria as


agreed jointly between, Jones Lang LaSalle and its subcontractors.
  
* Setting annual goals for generating savings in area of such as energy and cost of


maintenance operations.
  
* Ensure compliance of minimum wages acts for payments and statutory compliance


through specialist professionals.
  
* Ensure all the building compliances are achieved.

site

trainings.

to the delivery of maintenance services.
  
* Analyse call outs to understand trends; undertake strategic initiatives to minimize the


same.
  
* Scheduled cross feedback from subcontractors and develop a mechanism to improve


services level \& satisfaction scores.
  
* Train team members on all Quality policies \& procedures.
* Audit sub\-contractors on quality of materials \& upkeep of the site.
* Review the performance of Jones Lang LaSalle staff and conduct performance appraisals


from time to time.
  
* Interface with the Jones Lang LaSalle’s HR department and the Operations Director


and make recommendations for the future trainings given to the site facility management
  
team.
  
* Prepare and review the preventive maintenance register monthly and update the same to


Jones Lang LaSalle Operations Manager.
  
* Analyse call outs to understand trends; undertake strategic initiatives to minimize the


same.
  
* Tracking Contract Gross Margin and ensure that the opportunities are identified to


achieve CGM
  
* Ensure carrying out the following activities
* Report the monthly variance reporting – Budget vs Actuals vs Forecast
* Ensure IFM complies with Local JLL Finance policies and controls
* Prepare annual budget and quarterly forecast
* Monthly expense and debtors’ management
* Support Client/accounts’ billing and invoicing
* Deliver finance training programs to Operations and be part of discussion with client Finance teams to ensure that Finance scores are always high
* Work with site team to support contract pricing, pro\-forma reviews and provide


contract language inputs as required

* Timely and accurate reporting and quality analysis of financial results to senior


management
  
* Proactive resolution of financial and operational issues
* Partner the business to find improved ways of supporting business from a


financial perspective that have direct and indirect impact to profitability
  
* Interface with client and Jones Lang LaSalle finance department to raise client billing


invoicing and follow up with the client representatives for the payments.

* Develop MIS reports for Jones Lang LaSalle’s management team and


necessary client reporting.

Performance objectives

location

Morale and satisfaction of employees under management.

Skills, Experience and Education Qualification

experience in a corporate environment.

desirable. Proven ability to function effectively as part of a team. Proven
  
ability to initiate and follow through with improvement initiatives.
  
* Exposure and experience in dealing with multinational corporate


organizations.
  
* Strong Analytical skills.
* Good Leadership skills with ability to manage large teams
* Ability to adapt and perform under pressure
* Possess strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport


quickly.
  
* Good communication skills


**What this job involves:**  

In this role, your keen understanding of several angles in the site operations is crucial. You’ll provide full maintenance site services by carrying out building procedures and performance measures to guarantee that the facility is in top shape. Working with our corporate team, you’ll keep a close look at energy use, costs and building systems to find sweet spots and make informed decisions. On top of this, you should know exactly how to respond when issues come up. That’s why you’ll find it useful to always have an action plan to protect the site, and the health and safety of all staff members. Your ability to create great connections with vendors is also essential
  
to fulfil your site’s needs.
  
  

Leading a high\-powered team
  
  

You’ll play the part of both the motivator and connector who will pave the path for your team to succeed. Cultivating a culture of teamwork, excellence and sense of support should be second nature to you. You’ll also need to make sure that your team is well\-trained in the ins and outs of the facilities. You’ll go hand in hand with our senior account team to come up with new ways to develop your people’s skills and improve your team’s overall growth and success potential.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to have:**  

Tech know\-how and creativity
  
This role demands your tech expertise, so you should be skilled and competent in the field. Specifically, you should have top\-notch technical understanding, familiarity with EHS regulations, and experience with performance\-based service contracts and vendor management. Your out\-of\-the\-box thinking skills will also be helpful when problems and issues come your way.
  
  

A positive attitude
  
Are you able to connect with, engage and inspire the people around you? You should be able to develop positive rapport with different kinds of people. Strong written and verbal communication and analytical skills will also help you land the job.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Global Product Analyst (Level: Manager)
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As an HR Senior Product Analyst within BCG’s HR IT Systems Group, you will play a key role in the global implementation of our vendor management and external workforce system i.e. SAP Fieldglass. Working closely with the Transformation Product Owner, you’ll act as a functional expert, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support requirements, analyze, design, and implement system solutions that align with business goals and compliance standards.


You will help translate business objectives into scalable system solutions that support global contingent workforce and services procurement processes.


You’ll collaborate with Product teams, IT colleagues, and HR stakeholders globally to continuously improve Fieldglass’ ability to meet evolving business needs in external workforce management.


You will also contribute to the strategic roadmap for Fieldglass, enabling more effective engagement of contingent labor and services procurement while enhancing user satisfaction and data\-driven insights.


You will act as a key liaison between senior HR and procurement leadership and the delivery team, owning stakeholder communication, escalation management, and alignment across global and regional business units.


You will oversee workstream planning and sprint governance, ensuring backlog health, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery across cross\-functional Agile teams.


Among your responsibilities, you will:

* Gather and document global and regional business requirements
* Support design workshops and process mapping sessions
* Translate functional requirements into detailed configuration specifications
* Support system integrations with Workday, SAP S4HANA, and Coupa
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and SIT
* Validate data migration and perform reconciliation activities
* Assist in preparing deployment documentation and hypercare support
* Maintain comprehensive functional documentation
* Manage Product Backlog and agile delivery across sprints in partnership with Product Owner and scrum lead.
* Managed senior stakeholder relationships across, program, HR, Finance, Procurement and technology functions.
* Strive to ensure user stories are high quality as per agile best practices.

  

What You'll Bring

* 5–8 years in HR systems, VMS, procurement systems, or business systems as business analyst or support role
* 2\+ years hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass in an analyst or support capacity is required
* Experience participating in at least one SaaS implementation preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong background in HR operations, especially around contingent workforce or vendor management
* Proven experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into system specifications
* Skilled in creating functional documentation and understanding technical implications of proposed changes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess design changes from a system\-wide perspective
* Excellent communication skills and ability to build partnerships with internal stakeholders
* Experience managing application configurations and executing thorough test plans
* Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint for reporting, analytics, and presentation
* Familiarity with data privacy practices, especially as they relate to external workforce data
* Experience in a global and agile working environment is preferred
* Knowledge of system integrations, especially with procurement platforms like Coupa or HRIS systems like Workday is a plus

  

Who You'll Work With

* Other members of the transformation team, including support teams
* Global HR, procurement, Finance and data stakeholders managing contingent labor, vendor relationships and payments
* Agile delivery teams, including developers, QA, product owners, and change managers
* External partners like implementation partner, MSP and technical teams supporting SAP Fieldglass integrations

  

Additional info

**You’re Good At:**


In this global role, you will work with stakeholders, team members, and customers around the world. You should thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and demonstrate a strong focus on stakeholder needs and user experience.

* Translating complex business requirements into actionable SAP Fieldglass requirements for technology teams (configurations, integrations, data etc.)
* Supporting the Fieldglass Product Owner in planning and delivering transformation
* Supporting global template design and localization efforts
* Managing detailed documentation in a structured manner
* Demonstrating strong critical thinking skills when evaluating the broader impacts of system changes
* Working in fast\-paced transformation environments
* Managing and prioritizing backlog items using tools like Jira, ensuring timely delivery through agile sprint cycles
* Staying up to date with SAP Fieldglass trends, releases, and best practices to recommend future improvements

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

We attract great talent, ensure our processes and policies embody our core values, and we provide support in developing and managing our greatest assets \- our people. * Proficiency in MS Office; excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.

Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts.  C • C\+\+ • Python • Embedded Linux • MQTT • OCPP • CAN Bus • RS485 • Ethernet • ARM • ESP32 • STM32 • Raspberry Pi

Success in this role requires exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, sound judgment in addressing concerns, effective negotiation abilities, a personable and professional presence, and an analytical mindset for data analysis.

title: Manager - Administration
description:
Observer Research Foundation (ORF) is seeking an experienced ‘Manager\-Administration’ for its New Delhi office. This is a critical institutional role responsible for the smooth functioning of ORF's physical facilities and administrative operations.


The Office Manager will be the primary point of contact for all matters relating to office infrastructure, logistics, vendor relations, and day\-to\-day operational support. The individual in this role would work closely with the Finance, HR, Events, programme and management teams to ensure ORF operates efficiently as an institution.


### **Key responsibilities:**


**Facilities and Office Management**


* Oversee the upkeep, maintenance, and safety of ORF's office premises, ensuring a well\-functioning and professional working environment at all times.
* Manage relationships with vendors, and service providers; ensure timely resolution of repair, maintenance, and infrastructure issues.
* Oversee housekeeping, security, and utilities, ensuring adequate standards are maintained consistently; Support any office reconfiguration or expansion.
* Maintain and periodically review the office asset register including furniture, equipment, and supplies; coordinate procurement and replacement as needed.

**Administrative Operations**


* Oversee all administrative functions of the organisation, including procurement, vendor management, contract administration, and statutory compliance related to office operations.
* Manage and renew office contracts including AMCs, leases, insurance, and service agreements; maintain an organised repository of all institutional contracts and documents.
* Coordinate travel logistics for staff and visiting fellows, including ticketing, accommodation, visa support, and local transport arrangements.
* Support the development and implementation of administrative policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Employee and Contract Staff Welfare**


* Manage support staff, including office assistants, and housekeeping personnel; oversee their day\-to\-day work, attendance, and performance.
* Supervise a 2\-3 member admin team and support staff at ORF.

**Finance Support**


* Support the Finance team with processing of vendor invoices, expense claims, and petty cash management in line with ORF's financial policies.
* Assist in budget tracking for operational and administrative expenditures; flag deviations and coordinate with Management on approvals.
* Maintain documentation for all payments to support audit readiness.
* Coordinate with Finance on statutory payments and filings, including TDS and GST documentation as required.

**Conferences and Events Support**


* Provide logistical and operational support for ORF's events including conferences, roundtables, workshops, and international dialogues hosted at ORF or external venues.
* Coordinate with the programme and events teams on venue arrangements, catering, audio\-visual setup etc

**Qualifications and Requirements:**


* A graduate or postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related discipline.
* At least 8 years of experience in office or facilities management, preferably in a think tank, research institution, NGO, or professional services environment.
* Proven ability to manage vendors, contracts, and institutional procurement processes.
* Strong interpersonal skills and experience managing support staff and contract personnel.
* Familiarity with financial processes including invoice management, end to end payment workflow and budget tracking.
* Experience supporting event logistics and coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent organisational skills; ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced institutional environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); familiarity with basic ERP or administrative tools is an advantage. Familiarity with Tally would be desirable.
* Strong written and oral communication skills in English and Hindi.

**How to Apply**


To apply for this position, please submit your CV and a cover letter to jobs@orfonline.org with the subject line 'Manager\-Administration: Candidate Name'. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Assistant HR Manager
description:
With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.


If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.

  


The Assistant Human Resources Manager assists the Director of Human Resources to deal with daily operations, provide resources for management and coaching of team members to be effective managers of Human Resources within their area of responsibility. This role manages the Human Resources data for the hotel, and tracks the effectiveness of systems and programs, advising the Director of Human Resources on strategic issues related to the department.

  


**What will I be doing?**


As the Assistant Human Resources Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:


* Supervise team members in the HR office, ensuring the department’s daily operation is running smoothly and team members adhere to set disciplines.


* Liaise with local government authorities regarding labour law, labour relations and arbitration cases.


* Prepare procedures released concerning labour contracts for team members.


* Develop and maintain the team member relations programs, including social and sports activities, service award programs, and employee counseling to increase team members’ satisfaction.


* Take charge of recruitment according to hotel business requirements and the manning situation.


* Handle the check in / out for Level 8 and above team members.
* Supervise and check all records on sick leave, medical expenses, misconduct and the personnel action form.


* Supervise and support the HR Supervisor to manage the team member facilities.


* Maintain safety and cleanliness of work areas and team member areas, including but not limited to the team member restaurant and locker rooms.


* Supervise and support the HR Supervisor to maintain the smooth operations of Compensation \& Benefits.


* Strictly adhere to and ensure the security and confidentiality of the HR department.


* Initiate any new and improved systems / procedures to be implemented in order to upgrade all personnel filing systems and records.


* Handle arbitration cases to protect the hotel’s benefits.
* Handle team members’ complaints and communicate with other departments.


* Be in charge of HR audits and standardize HR operations.


* Build HR policies and procedures to increase the efficiency of the department.


* Build an environment of support with other departments.


* Carry out manning analyses, exit interviews and turnover analyses.


* Ensure that team members maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, adhering to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.


* Conduct HR related market surveys to promptly adjust strategy.


* Handle foreigner work permits and visa application.
* Discipline team members.


* Assume the duty of the Director of HR during his / her absence.


* Adhere to the hotel’s security and emergency policies and procedures.


* Ensure that all team members have a complete understanding of and adhere to the hotel’s team member rules and regulations.


* Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.


* The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.

**What are we looking for?**


An Assistant Human Resources Manager, serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:


* College degree and above.


* Minimum 5 years of working experience in the hotel industry.


* Minimum 1 year of experience in a similar position with an international brand hotel.


* Good analysis and planning skills.


* Open minded and a good team player.


* Good communication skills.


* Fluent in written and spoken English to meet business needs.


* Good relationship with the local labour bureau and government agencies.


* Thorough knowledge of federal, state and local labour laws.


* Thorough knowledge of HR modules and department operations.


* Possess basic business and financial sense.


* Strong ownership and result driven.


* Good organization and presentation skills.

  


**What will it be like to work for Hilton?**


Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full\-service hotels and resorts to extended\-stay suites and mid\-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: Data Analyst - HR
description:
Data Analytics Manager – HR Analytics  

Role Summary  

We are looking for a Data Analytics Manager – HR Analytics to lead the development of  

people analytics and workforce insights across the organization. This role will partner closely  

with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to provide data\-driven insights  

that support strategic decision\-making.  

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience working with HR data, and  

the ability to translate complex information into meaningful business recommendations.  

⸻  

Key Responsibilities  

HR Analytics \& Reporting* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports covering key workforce metrics, including:
* Headcount
* Attrition
* Hiring and recruitment performance
* Diversity metrics
* Employee engagement
* Internal mobility
* Workforce costs
* Analyze workforce trends and provide insights to support business and HR

  

decision\-making.* Produce regular and ad hoc reports for leadership teams.

  

Workforce Planning \& Insights* Support workforce planning, budgeting, and organizational reviews through data analysis.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to talent acquisition, retention, and

  

workforce effectiveness.* Provide actionable recommendations to improve organizational performance and employee

  

outcomes.  

Data Management \& Governance* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of HR data across systems.
* Partner with HRIS, Technology, and Finance teams to improve data quality and reporting

  

processes.* Maintain data governance standards and ensure confidentiality of employee information.

  

Dashboarding \& Automation* Build and enhance self\-service dashboards and reporting solutions.
* Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.
* Leverage analytics tools and emerging technologies to strengthen reporting capabilities.

  

Stakeholder Management* Partner with HR leaders, Talent Acquisition teams, Finance, and business stakeholders to

  

understand reporting and analytics requirements.* Present findings and insights in a clear and meaningful way to support decision\-making.

  

⸻  

Qualifications \& Experience* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Human

  

Resources, or a related field.* 5–8 years of experience in HR Analytics, People Analytics, Workforce Planning, Business

  

Intelligence, or a related analytics role.* Experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Experience in a global organization is preferred.

  

⸻  

Technical Skills* Strong proficiency in:
* Power BI or Tableau
* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Experience working with HR systems such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or

  

similar platforms.* Knowledge of workforce analytics and reporting methodologies.
* Experience with Python, AI\-enabled analytics tools, or predictive analytics is an advantage.

  

⸻  

Key Competencies* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to convert data into practical business insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

  

⸻  

Reporting Structure  

Reports To: Global Head of HR / Head of People Analytics  

Location: Mumbai  

⸻  

Why Join Us?  

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a data\-driven people strategy within a global,  

fast\-paced, and innovative organization. You will work closely with senior leaders to influence  

workforce decisions and build analytics capabilities that create measurable business impact.

About the Company

Raynas Infra and Geomatics Services Pvt. Ltd. is a growing organization specializing in infrastructure development, geomatics solutions, land surveying, mapping, and project execution. We provide accurate, reliable, and technology\-driven surveying services for infrastructure, utilities, and land development projects.

Role Overview

The GPR Survey Engineer will be responsible for conducting subsurface investigations using Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) technology. The role involves collecting and interpreting geophysical data, preparing survey documentation, and supporting engineering teams with essential subsurface insights for safe and efficient project execution. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in GPR operations, data analysis, and field coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct GPR surveys for subsurface utility detection, pavement analysis, geotechnical investigations, and structural assessments.
* Operate GPR instruments and related geophysical equipment with precision.
* Collect, process, and interpret radar data to identify underground utilities, voids, pipelines, and structural features.
* Prepare survey reports, subsurface maps, and technical documentation using CAD/GIS tools.
* Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and site teams to integrate GPR findings into project planning and execution.
* Ensure proper calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of GPR instruments.
* Maintain accurate field logs, daily reports, and measurement records.

* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, layouts, and site plans.
* Strong communication skills and willingness to work in varied field conditions across Mumbai.

* Competitive salary and field allowances

* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation

* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver  



  

1\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
  

  

3\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Financials
  

  

Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
  

  

5\.
  

  

Capability Building
  

  

% attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
  

  

6\.
  

  

Team Management
  

  

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score  

  



**͏**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Linux System Administrator to join our Jaipur team and manage enterprise Linux environments, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, and hosting services.

* Configure and manage firewalls, Fail2Ban, CSF, and intrusion prevention systems.

* Manage backup solutions and disaster recovery processes.
* Conduct routine security audits and vulnerability assessments.

* Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and routing.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and autonomous **Field Service Engineer (FSE)** to join our service team. In this role, you will be the face of our company, responsible for the installation, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of our cutting\-edge medical device equipment within hospitals, clinical laboratories, and imaging centers.

Customer Relations \& Compliance

* **Degree/Certification:** Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical discipline. *Equivalent military training (e.g., BMET, electronics) is highly valued.*

* Freshers can also apply

Technical \& Soft Skills

* Strong ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical blueprints.
* Proficiency with diagnostic tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, patient simulators).
* Basic understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DICOM, HL7\).
* Exceptional communication skills—ability to explain complex technical issues to non\-technical hospital staff.

Physical \& Logistics Requirements

title: Lead Exit and Benefits Administration
description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Lead – Payroll and Benefits
   

  

**Role Overview:** 
 The Lead – Exit \& Benefits Administration is responsible for end\-to\-end management of employee exits and benefits administration for a high\-volume sales workforce. The role ensures timely, compliant, and accurate closure of exits and post\-exit formalities, effective administration of insurance benefits along with driving process efficiency, automation, and system\-led improvements to enable scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Exit Management
* Own end\-to\-end exit administration for high volume exits( 800\-1000 per week) including resignation processing, separation documentation, and system updates while ensuring payroll accuracy and compliance.
* Ensure timely and compliant closure of exits in line with statutory, payroll, and internal policy timelines.


**Coordinate with payroll, HRBPs, finance, and business teams for seamless exit execution.**
* Post\-Exit Formalities \& Documentation
* Ensure accurate and timely issuance of:
+ Relieving and experience letters
+ Full \& Final settlement inputs
+ Statutory exit documentation (PF, ESIC, gratuity where applicable)
+ Show cause and termination letters as required for the respective cases (absconding, involuntary exits, etc.)

* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and records for all exits.
* Recovery Management
* Manage employee recoveries, dues reconciliation, and write\-offs as per policy and delegated authority.
* Liaise with the legal function for issuance of legal notices and follow\-up in critical or high\-value cases.
* Ensure strong controls and documentation for all recovery and write\-off decisions.
* Insurance Administration
* Oversee employee insurance administration across the lifecycle, including:
+ Benefits enrolments
+ Claims support and coordination with insurers / TPAs
+ Employee query resolution

* Ensure benefits continuity, accuracy, and compliance for the employees.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or sensitive benefits cases.
* Time\-Off / Leave Management
* Own end\-to\-end time\-off (leave) administration for the sales workforce, ensuring accurate application, approval, and system recording.
* Ensure leave data integrity for payroll processing, benefits eligibility, exit settlement and actuarial valuations.
* Manage exceptions such as:
+ Backdated leave
+ Incorrect balances
+ Leave adjustments at exit / absconding stage

* Process Excellence, Automation \& Systems
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and standardise exit and benefits processes.
* Partner with HRIS, payroll systems, and internal tech teams to:
+ Reduce manual interventions
+ Improve data accuracy
+ Enable real\-time tracking and reporting

* Build scalable workflows to support sustained high\-volume operations.
* Compliance, Controls \& Governance
* Ensure all exit and benefits processes comply with:
+ Labour laws and statutory requirements
+ Internal policies and delegation of authority
+ Audit and data privacy standards


**Support internal and external audits related to exits, benefits, and employee settlements.** 
**Proactively flag risks impacting compliance, cost, or employee experience.**
- Stakeholder \& Team Management

- Act as a key SPOC for HRBPs, payroll, finance, legal, and business teams on exit\- and benefits\-related matters.

- Publish regular MIS covering:

* Exit volumes and closure timelines
* Absconding and recovery status
* Benefits enrolments and claims trends
* Lead and guide a team of Exit and Benefits specialists
* Allocate work, manage capacity, and ensure consistent output quality.
* Regular reviews, coaching, and issue resolution to maintain operational discipline and handling volume spikes, complexity, and stakeholder interactions.
* Drive standardisation of SOPs, trackers, checklists and escalation mechanisms.


**Key Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate / Postgraduate in HR or a related field with 4\-5 years of experience in HR Operations, Benefits Administration (Insurance), or Payroll
* Prior experience leading teams and driving process improvements/ automations in large, fast\-growing organisations is essential.
* High ownership, attention to detail, compliance and execution orientation
* Ability to operate under tight timelines and high pressure
* Strong stakeholder management and analytical skills; comfort with MIS and dashboards.
* Proficient in MS Excel/ Google spreadsheets.


**PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)**
* Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
* Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
* Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Manager, People
